title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Fifty thousand Pesos, Not Otherwise Appropriated, for the Extermination of Locusts.

text.en:
The sum of fifty thousand pesos Philippine currency is hereby appropriated out of any Insular
funds not otherwise appropriated, to be expended in the destruction of locusts, in accordance with the
provisions of Act Numbered Twenty-one hundred and twenty-one.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall iake effect on its
passage, in accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, November 10, 1913.
